title: THE SHOP SAYS HOW MANY YOU BOUGHT
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. At the shop you can raise the amount with + and buy several at once. Five Bandages took $3,300 and all five arrived, but the message said Bought Bandage for $660, because each unit is bought one at a time and each said its own line over the last. The shop now says the whole order once: how many, and what they cost together.
now: Buying several of one item at the shop now says how many you bought and what all of them cost.
